text:
Complete phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high-intensity exercise normally takes about 8 minutes. About half the store returns in roughly 30 seconds and most of it within a few minutes; the roughly 10-second figure is how long the phosphagen system can power maximal effort, which is a different interval from full repletion. Strength-and-conditioning references use about 8 minutes for complete creatine-phosphate restoration after that kind of work.

CONFIDENCE: 86
